tool.name: Arriba Get Filters
tool.command: ARIBA_BIN="\$(which arriba)" && REF_DIR="\${ARIBA_BIN%/bin/arriba}/var/lib/arriba" && cp "\$REF_DIR/blacklist_${arriba_reference_name}_v@TOOL_VERSION@.tsv.gz" '$blacklist' && cp "\$REF_DIR/known_fusions_${arriba_reference_name}_v@TOOL_VERSION@.tsv.gz" '$known_fusions' && cp "\$REF_DIR/protein_domains_${arriba_reference_name}_v@TOOL_VERSION@.gff3" '$protein_domains' && cp "\$REF_DIR/cytobands_${arriba_reference_name}_v@TOOL_VERSION@.tsv" '$cytobands'

param.name: arriba_reference_name
param.label: Select reference
param.help: Reference files are bundled with the Arriba installation and match the assembly used for STAR alignment.

tool.help:
**Arriba Get Filters**
Arriba_ is a fast tool to search for aberrant transcripts such as gene fusions. It is based on chimeric alignments found by the STAR RNA-Seq aligner.
The **Arriba Get Filters** tool adds the following Arriba distribution input_files_ to your galaxy history:
- blacklist - known_fusions - protein_domains - cytobands
.. _Arriba: https://github.com/suhrig/arriba/wiki/01-Home .. _input_files: https://github.com/suhrig/arriba/wiki/04-Input-files
